set.tovw: Grade F (treasure thread): the jewelry cache was dug up by police in 1914; history marker
set.pl: The farm's 235-acre strip in the E-central part of sec 34 T90N R30W (Jackson Twp), house mark near its S end, 1909 atlas; about 4 mi N of Barnum.
pinev: 1909 Standard Atlas of Webster Co p.41 (Jackson Twp) shows the named farm in sec 34 with a residence mark near the S end; checked against BLM PLSS sec 34 (42.559-42.573, -94.383 to -94.364) and the 4-mile distance from Barnum.
set.t: Recovered by police in 1914; history marker only. Private farm.
